description: Get live application logs (runtime output from the running service). NOT deploy-time build logs — use get_deploy_logs for those. Returns recent log entries with timestamp, message, and level. Use after check_app_health returns unhealthy to diagnose runtime errors, crashes, or request failures. If logAvailability.ready is false, logs may take a few seconds to become available on GCP — retry shortly. For multi-service projects, use service_id to target a specific service.

limit.description: Max log entries to return (1-1000). Default 100.

service_id.description: Optional service ID for multi-service projects.

name: get_app_logs
